seal.statement: The lagrange.management.v1 HTTP surface fails closed on authority and never reports fabricated state. /management/v1/* routes refuse before any management owner exists or acts when control-plane credentials are unconfigured (typed CONTROL_PLANE_AUTH_UNCONFIGURED) or the presented credentials are wrong; the cluster identity comes only from the established cluster record, reads as unknown when unestablished and refuses identity-bound operations with a typed code, and the genuine identity survives restart and restore; absent runtime health, capacity and topology snapshots read as unknown with a typed reason and never grant operation admission; backup, restore, rolling upgrade and node decommission without their installed physical adapters are refused as capability-unsupported before any effect and can never report SUCCEEDED, with no in-memory or synthetic substitute in production composition. Node-to-node bootstrap/registration route authentication is out of scope (0.5 cluster trust) and is recorded as a finding.
